query.text: 我是道路维护人员，请帮我观察中央隔离设施的调整，设施开始移动或改变车道分隔位置时告诉我。
query.text_en: I am maintaining the road. Please observe the central barrier adjustment and tell me when it starts moving or changes the lane separation.

annotation.text_zh: 中央隔离设施正在被转移，车道分隔位置正在改变。
annotation.text_en: The central barrier is being shifted, changing the lane separation.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
